Laravel application; follow existing conventions and these versions: inertiajs/inertia-laravel v2, laravel/fortify v1, laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/wayfinder v0, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12.

Activate relevant domain skills whenever working in that domain:
- `wayfinder-development` — whenever referencing backend routes in frontend components: importing from `@/actions` or `@/routes`, calling Laravel routes from TypeScript, or working with Wayfinder route functions.
- `pest-testing` — whenever writing tests, creating unit or feature tests, adding assertions, testing Livewire components, browser testing, debugging test failures, working with datasets or mocking; or when the user mentions test, spec, TDD, expects, assertion, coverage, or needs to verify functionality works.

Follow existing code conventions; check sibling files for structure, approach, and naming. Use descriptive variable and method names. Check for existing components to reuse before writing a new one. Stick to existing directory structure; don't create new base folders without approval. Do not change the application's dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Be concise in explanations.

Use Laravel Boost MCP tools. Use `list-artisan-commands` when checking Artisan command parameters. Use `get-absolute-url` whenever sharing a project URL. Use `tinker` to execute PHP for debugging or querying Eloquent models; use `database-query` for database reads and `database-schema` to inspect tables before writing migrations or models. Use `browser-logs` to read browser logs, errors, and exceptions; ignore old logs.

Search documentation before code changes. ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Laravel, Inertia, and Pest documentation and updated examples. Boost uses installed package versions to return relevant docs; pass an array of packages when known. Use multiple broad, simple, topic-based queries. Do not add package names to queries. Queries support auto-stemming, AND logic, quoted exact phrases, mixed terms, and multiple queries (any term).

Always use curly braces for control structures, even for single-line bodies. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion in `__construct()`, e.g. `public function __construct(public GitHub $github) { }`. Do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless the constructor is private. Always use explicit return type declarations and appropriate parameter type hints. Prefer PHPDoc blocks over inline comments. Never use comments within the code itself unless the logic is exceptionally complex. Add useful array shape type definitions when appropriate. Enum keys are typically TitleCase.

The app is served by Laravel Herd at `https?://[kebab-case-project-dir].test`; use `get-absolute-url` for valid URLs. You must not run any commands to make the site available via HTTP(S). If frontend changes aren't reflected, ask the user to run `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`.

Every change must be programmatically tested. Write a new test or update an existing test, then run affected tests. Run the minimum number needed; use `php artisan test --compact` with a specific filename or filter.

Inertia: Components live in `resources/js/pages` unless `vite.config.js` specifies otherwise. Use `Inertia::render()` instead of Blade views. Use all v1/v2 features; check docs before changes. For deferred props, add an empty state with a pulsing or animated skeleton.

Laravel: Use `php artisan make:` to create files (migrations, controllers, models, etc.); use `php artisan make:class` for generic PHP classes. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands and correct `--options`. Use proper Eloquent relationship methods with return type hints; prefer relationships and Eloquent models over raw queries/manual joins. Avoid `DB::`; prefer `Model::query()`. Prevent N+1 queries with eager loading; use Laravel's query builder for very complex database operations. For new models, create useful factories and seeders; ask whether the user needs anything else, using `list-artisan-commands` to check `php artisan make:model` options. For APIs, default to Eloquent API Resources and API versioning unless existing routes don't, then follow existing conventions. Always create Form Request classes for validation instead of inline controller validation; include rules and custom error messages, and check sibling requests for array- or string-based rules. Use Laravel authentication/authorization (gates, policies, Sanctum, etc.). Prefer named routes and `route()` for links. Use queued jobs for time-consuming operations with `ShouldQueue`. Use environment variables only in configuration files—never use `env()` outside config; use `config('app.name')`, not `env('APP_NAME')`. For test models, use factories and check custom states first. Follow existing Faker convention: `$this->faker->word()` or `fake()->randomDigit()`. Create tests with `php artisan make:test [options] {name}`; pass `--unit` for unit tests; most tests should be feature tests. On `Illuminate\Foundation\ViteException: Unable to locate file in Vite manifest`, run `npm run build` or ask the user to run `npm run dev` or `composer run dev`.

Laravel 12 uses the streamlined Laravel 11 structure: middleware are configured in `bootstrap/app.php` via `Application::configure()->withMiddleware()`, not `app/Http/Kernel.php`. `bootstrap/app.php` registers middleware, exceptions, and routing files; `bootstrap/providers.php` holds application providers. `app\Console\Kernel.php` no longer exists; use `bootstrap/app.php` or `routes/console.php`. Commands in `app/Console/Commands/` are auto-available. When modifying a column, include all previously defined attributes in the migration or they will be dropped. Laravel 12 supports limiting eager-loaded records natively, e.g. `$query->latest()->limit(10);`. Prefer model `casts()` over `$casts` when consistent with sibling models.

Wayfinder: Import from `@/actions/` (controllers) or `@/routes/` (named routes). Invokable controllers: `import StorePost from '@/actions/.../StorePostController'; StorePost()`. Parameter binding detects route keys (`{post:slug}`), e.g. `show({ slug: "my-post" })`. Query merging: `show(1, { mergeQuery: { page: 2, sort: null } })`; `null` removes params. Inertia: use `.form()` with `<Form>` or `form.submit(store())` with useForm.

Pint: You must run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` before finalizing changes. Do not run `vendor/bin/pint --test --format agent`, simply run `vendor/bin/pint --format agent` to fix formatting issues.

Pest: Create tests with `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`. Run `php artisan test --compact` or `php artisan test --compact --filter=testName`. Do NOT delete
